author: Saeed Elfiky
description: Detects PowerShell execution using an encoded command.
false_positives: Legitimate administrative scripts using encoded PowerShell commands
name: SIGMA - PowerShell Encoded Command
query: from logs-endpoint* metadata _id, _index, _version | where (ends_with(process.executable, "\\powershell.exe") or ends_with(process.executable, "\\pwsh.exe")) and (process.command_line like "* -EncodedCommand *" or process.command_line like "* -EncodedCommand=*" or process.command_line like "* -enc *" or process.command_line like "* -enc=*" or process.command_line like "* -e *" or process.command_line like "* -e=*")
